text:
maya: quick one — where's the canonical GPU observability dashboard for SM% / GPU mem / KV cache hitrate / batch-size trends? need screenshots for perf sync tomorrow morning :grimacing:

alex: use the GPU Overview dash in the console — it has SM% heatmap + per-pool KV cache panels. link: https://console.redwood-inference.internal/dashboards/gpu_overview :point_up:

sam: FWIW the batch-size histogram is under the workload tab of the same dash (bottom-left). If you want a per-model view, switch the `model` drop-down.

maya: thanks — do we have the exact panel ids? would like to deep-link into the doc I'm prepping.

alex: panel ids (rough): SM% = 87, mem usage = 92, KV hitrate = 108, batch size histogram = 115. deep links look like: https://console.redwood-inference.internal/d/GPu_OVw/gpu_overview?panelId=87

linh: if you need raw traces for a specific noisy window, look in Tempo: https://traces.redwood-inference.internal/search and filter by `resource.gpu.instance` + `trace.span` containing `kv-cache` or `batch`.

maya: perfect — and alerts? want to suggest a small tuning: reduce noise from transient KV cache evictions. which alert is firing?

ops-sre: dev-alert `kvcache_eviction_rate_high` is the one. It's at `/alerts/gpu/kvcache_eviction_rate_high` in the runbook. Current rule: `increase(quantile_over_time(0.9, kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) > 5` which is noisy on many short-lived pods.

maya: yup that's the one. can we change it to look at sustained evictions across pool instead of per-pod?

ops-sre: proposal in runbook: aggregate by `pool` and require 15m sustained window + per-minute rate > 2. Example prom rule snippet I drafted:```yaml
- alert: KVCacheHighEvictionByPool
  expr: >-
    sum by (pool) (increase(kvcache_evictions_total[15m])) / 15 > 2
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```

sam: that seems reasonable. Also consider backing off alert for canaries (label `canary=true`).

alex: +1. Also note memory panel has a per-instance smem breakdown; if SM% spikes without mem growth it's likely scheduling/oversubscribe not model blowup.

maya: for the perf sync I also want a quick PromQL to show recent SM% 1m avg across dedicated pools. anyone got a concise one?

linh: try: `avg_over_time(gpu_sm_utilization[1m])` but scoped to pools:```promql
avg by (pool) (avg_over_time(gpu_sm_utilization{env="prod"}[1m]))
```

maya: awesome — I'll paste that into the doc. last q: any short tips for screenshots (time range, smoothing) to show meaningful trends?

alex: pick a 6h window for day-to-day anomalies, 72h for capacity trends. set resolution to 1m for SM% charts, and enable `staircase` on batch histograms so discrete buckets are clearer.

infra-bot: deploy notice: grafana/dashboards/gpu_overview updated by alex at 2026-11-02T14:42:10Z :robot_face:

maya: perfect — thanks everyone :pray: will share the doc in #eng-runtime before the sync.
